MAHALAGANG ABISO SA MGA MOTORISTA🚦

Asahan ang pagbigat ng daloy ng trapiko sa October 25, 2025 (Sabado) mula 5:00 AM - 7:30 AM sa paligid ng Claret School of Quezon City sa Teacher’s Village East dahil sa gaganaping HABIKASAN ECO RUN ng nasabing paaralan bilang bahagi ng pagdiriwang ng kanilang Foundation Week.

Kabilang sa ruta ang mga sumusunod na kalsada:

• Malamig St.
• Matahimik St.
• Malingap St. 
• Mapagkawanggawa St.
• Matimtiman St.

Magtutulungan at nakaantabay din ang mga tauhan ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD), at Department of Public Order and Safety (DPOS) para maisaayos ang daloy ng trapiko sa mga nabanggit na kalsada.

Pinapayuhan ang mga motorista na dumaan sa mga alternatibong ruta. Salamat po sa inyong pang-unawa.

data.text:
Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said he is not discounting the possibility of arson in the fire that broke out at the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) office in Quezon City on Wednesday.

"Pinapunta ko na ang NBI do’n at saka I asked my brother (DILG Sec. Jonvic Remulla) to help the BFP look at the arson angle. Kung merong arson na involved dito," he said in an interview with The Philippine STAR editor-in-chief Amy Pamintuan.

The fire-hit DPWH office allegedly receives a one-percent kickback from flood control projects, according to Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) chair Andres Reyes.

Meanwhile, the DPWH assured the public that no documents related to the ongoing investigation into flood control anomalies were destroyed in the blaze.

“Initial findings indicate that the fire originated from a computer unit inside the Materials Testing Division that reportedly exploded,” the agency said. #TruthOnTheLine
